scope: Retrospective clarification check only; preserves historical seed08 grades. Final expanded readers must freshly satisfySC02.

a.exact_answer: A Release into the Wild project matches an animal's printed standard-enclosure requirement to a size band, not necessarily a single exact size: 2− accepts size 1 or 2, 3 accepts size 3, and 4+ accepts size 4 or 5. Discard the animal and lose its icons; first lose only its printed appeal, before gaining conservation. Keep conservation, reputation, ability-generated appeal, and earlier effects already earned. Playing a new Release project grants 1 reputation; supporting one already in play does not. To free space, if the animal could live in a special enclosure, remove its indicated special-enclosure tokens first if possible; otherwise flip the smallest occupied standard enclosure meeting all requirements, then fall back to the smallest meeting size alone, or flip none if none meets size.
a.priority_check: The answer directs first removing the indicated eligible special-enclosure tokens if possible, with standard-enclosure fallback only otherwise. This expresses mandatory priority; no optional-choice statement.
